parse_behaviors.derivation: Entries begin at 4; floor((receive_count-4)/4) entries of DTCbe24,status8. Status availability is byte3; matching masks select records.

send_behavior_query.derivation: Replace request bytes2/3 with resolved status-mask OR and memory11/12/13; NRC31 clears receive data and records success.

resolve_status_masks.derivation: Each requested status-key bit resolves type66 (0x242); row+8 is mask, +9 comparison value; OR comparison values into request byte2.

join_behavior_dictionary.derivation: Type163 key is returned DTCbe24; enabled byte3E gates known codes; byte3F overrides memory when nonzero; absent rows use fallback XP/XC/XB/XU signature and ??? name. Duplicate DTCs merge status masks.

parse_snapshot_blocks.derivation: Count at8, blocks at9; type90 fixed length+4 or wire u8/<9000,be16/>=9000; stop on truncated header/payload; count0 scans to response end; retain first duplicate DID.

join_signals.derivation: Scan type164 rows whose DID+24 matches block; collect key+14 then keyed lookup. Require (bit_end>>3)+1 <= payload_count; extraction4 uses buffer helper, all other modes scalar helper.

cross_did_support.derivation: Variable length must equal2; interpret its two bytes as DIDbe16. Find that DID in the same returned record, require condition7, extract MSB0 bits and admit nonzero.

local_support.derivation: Type90 modes0/2 include;1 uses preceding-byte MSB0 mask at signal end-bit; other modes log error. Nonzero signal+16 joins type89. Presentation1 forces include after successful support evaluation; internal support errors are logged and this helper returns success with default exclusion.

fetch_snapshot.derivation: Selector12C request bytes2..4=DTCbe24,5=frame8,6=memory; successful receive calls parse_snapshot_blocks.

special_signal_keys.derivation: Type91 key selects row+2 signal key.

init_snapshot.derivation: Load type164 (0x2A4), initialize special keys, GetCommFrmInfo selector12C.

emit_signal.derivation: Presentation0/1 emits signal;2 only contributes special fields. Special keys1/2 select output slots with raw invalid sentinels FFFF/FFFFFFFF; key11 for categories1783/1977 uses1FFFFFFF. Keys4..9 decode BCD year/month/day/hour/minute/second with limits100,1..12,1..31,24,60,60; FF is invalid. Complete six-field date sets valid flag.

signal_metadata.derivation: Name+10, extraction+28, physical key+18 -> type13, unit from physical+E ->type15; copy mul/div/offset/sign/precision and signal bit width. Copy double bounds+0/+8, pattern+20 ->type14; absent pattern optionally joins type118 by signal key for factor text/help. No dynamic-LSB call.

init_special_slots.derivation: Resolve type91 keys1,2,4..9; categories1783/1977 additionally key11.

finalize_special_slots.derivation: For categories1783/1977, if any record uses special key11, clear key2's competing slot.

parse_routine_blocks.derivation: Same block grammar as snapshot, but count at9 and blocks at10.

fetch_routine_record.derivation: Selector12D request bytes2..3=returned RIDbe16;4..7=framebe32; successful receive calls parse_routine_blocks.

init_routine_record.derivation: Load type164 (0x2A4), initialize special keys, GetCommFrmInfo selector12D.

parse_byte_frames.derivation: Entries from12, one byte each. Keep1..1F and80..EF; sort and deduplicate.

parse_dword_frames.derivation: Entries from12, floor((receive_count-12)/4) big-endian dwords. Reject0 and values whose high nibble in byte0 or2 isF; sort and deduplicate.

send_frame_query.derivation: Selector12B request4..6=DTCbe24,7=memory. If receive_count>=12, format=byte9 and fetch RID=be16[10:12].

dispatch_frame_format.derivation: Format0 dispatches byte-frame parser;1 dword-frame parser; others succeed with no parsed frame entries.

execute.derivation: Accept request mode2 and acquisition kind1/2; input memory IDs11/12/13 carry status-key masks. Kind1 prepares frame/fetch objects, runs P6 enabled-RID discovery and fetches only if D000 supported; kind2 enumerates only. Set session wait70ms. Enumerated entries survive ten accepted communication-error results; fatal errors propagate. No supported status query returns A004020B.

extract_scalar.derivation: MSB0 inclusive extraction to u32. For ranges<=32 bits this is ordinary big-endian extraction; wider ranges OR-fold bytes because x86 shifts use count&31 and results wrap32. Caller enforces payload end bounds.

extract_buffer.derivation: Mode4 copies inclusive byte span into a 4096-byte local buffer; first byte shifted left by start&7, last byte right by7-(end&7), interior bytes unchanged. Single-byte span is additionally width-masked.

table_kind.derivation: Logical table high byte selects family, low byte is physical table index: 2A3->163,2A4->164,25A->90,259->89,25B->91. No151/153 substitution.

behavior_strings.derivation: Type163 string refs+30,+38,+34 feed name/comment/division respectively; signature is inline UTF16 at0.

signal_name.derivation: Type164 OEM name string reference is u32+10.

physical_arithmetic.derivation: Sign0 unsigned,1 two's-complement,3 sign-magnitude; other modes unsigned. Signed64 multiply, signed division truncated toward zero unless divisor's u32 value<=1, then add offset to low32 result.

conversion_table.derivation: CComDataConvert basic overload receives conversion-table mul+8,div+C,offset+10,sign+16,width+18.

pattern_lookup.derivation: CCmdFrzFrmDat GetString calls GetValue then compares converted integer to pattern entries; unmatched returns null.

freeze_frame_value.derivation: CCmdFrzFrmDat GetValue selects multi-data by index and passes raw u32 to basic conversion-table overload; extraction/presentation mode does not choose the special-format arithmetic overload.

routine_bitmap.derivation: MSB-first bitmap sets IDs base+byte_index*8+bit_index when shift-mode0.

routine_support.derivation: SelectorCC reads D100 root, at most32 bitmap bytes from response5; reads enabled D1nn pages except D1F0..D1FE and expands from base(page<<8). Cached per ECU; failed communication may yield empty enabled set.

transport_contract.block: DIDbe16 | optional wire length | data; type90+4 nonzero omits wire length; else u8 for DID<9000 orbe16 for>=9000
transport_contract.bounds: behavior list requires>=4 bytes and ignores partial final4-byte entry; frame response<12 leaves formatFF and emits no frames; block headers and payloads must fit receive length; truncated tail stops parsing; count0 scans complete blocks to end; duplicate DID keeps first

synthetic_scalar_witnesses.source: NCM_P6/P6F type164 rows32..34 use this 80-bit span; payload is synthetic

p5_differences: P5 AB01/11 behaviorbe16 becomes P6 1917 DTCbe24/status8 with three memory selections.
P5 AB02/12 framebe16 becomes P6 D000 routine enumerating either frame8 or framebe32 plus a returned fetch RID.
P5 AB03/13 count6/blocks7 becomes P6 1918 count8/blocks9 or routine count9/blocks10.
P5 DID6000..6FFF has wirebe32 length; P6 prioritizes type90 fixed length, then wireu8/<9000 orwirebe16/>=9000.
P5 type87/88 (behavior16,signal72B) becomes P6 type163/164 (DTC24,signal48B); no type151/153 substitution and no ChangeSignalLSB in the recovered P6 RoB metadata path.
remaining_questions: ECU-specific enabled RIDs, returned frame format/fetch RID/record IDs and actual payloads require an observed response; offline DDBs contain no runtime record catalog.
Mode4 buffer extraction has no current NA/EU/JP bound-catalog witness; its native helper is retained, including its fixed4096-byte local-buffer assumption.
Unconsumed row bytes remain raw; missing regional ECU databases are enumerated, not treated as zero-signal catalogs.
